CustomField.description: Age in days since Broker First Seen (fallback CreatedDate), formatted "Nd". Mirrors Lead.Days_in_System__c exactly, including its shape as Text rather than Number - so this field sorts lexicographically ("10d" < "9d"), same as the Lead field. That is a known, accepted mirroring consequence, not a defect. ⚠ TIMEZONE NOTE: DATEVALUE() on the underlying DateTime field resolves in GMT, so a Broker_First_Seen__c instant after ~18:00 US Central can read one day older here than local wall-clock expectation. Same known, accepted quirk as the Lead field - not fixed here to avoid diverging from established Lead behavior.
CustomField.label: Days in System
